blocks.text: A ship approaches the Panama Canal locks between green banks, Panama
Panama Canal from above: A ship approaching the locks

Breakfast at the hotel. Depart at 08:00.

El Valle de Antón lies within a volcanic caldera. The valley takes its name from the El Valle de Antón stratovolcano. Its caldera, with a radius of 6 km, formed about 1.1–1.3 million years ago. People settled here several thousand years ago, and today a town stands inside the caldera.

The capital and rural Panama feel like two different worlds on this trip. After the bustle of Panama City, life here is quiet and unhurried.

The town sits inside a volcanic crater. Fewer than ten places in the world have settlements directly inside a volcanic crater. The climate is mild, with an average daytime temperature of about 28 °C and an average night-time temperature of around 20 °C throughout the year, with little variation between summer and winter.

In Antón Valley, you will visit the Central Market, where stalls sell vegetables, fruit, flowers, orchids, souvenirs and locally made crafts. The market is especially lively on Sundays, when people from nearby villages bring ceramics, wooden sculptures and tableware, soapstone crafts, local coconut sweets and jewellery made with semiprecious stones. Soapstone is regarded here as a rare material, associated with deposits in India and Panama.

Most of the town’s residents descend from the Indigenous Guaymí people, who lived here before Europeans arrived.

One of the valley’s landmarks is La India Dormida, or the Sleeping Indian Woman, a mountain named for a young woman in a local legend. Her image often appears on souvenirs.

Your next stop is Chorro del Macho, the tallest waterfall in the area, with a drop of 70 metres.

**Canopy tour above Chorro del Macho waterfall**

The canopy tour costs extra.

Downstream, you can swim in a natural pool fed by running water. The water temperature is 26–28 °C.

During the excursion, you will also visit the privately owned El Níspero Zoo and Botanical Garden.

Lunch is not included today. Your guide will recommend local restaurants. The canopy tour costs extra.

After the excursion, transfer back to the hotel.
